article.story: HARRISONBURG, Va. -- — Dorian Finister scored 18 points, including a go-ahead 3-pointer with 1.2 seconds left, to help Louisiana defeat James Madison 64-61 on Wednesday night. Finister also had six rebounds for the Ragin' Cajuns (8-16, 6-6 Sun Belt Conference). Dariyus Woodson scored 14 points while shooting 4 for 5 from beyond the arc and added five rebounds. De'Vion Lavergne had 14 points and shot 5 for 13, including 2 for 6 from beyond the arc. The Dukes (11-13, 4-8) were led in scoring by Cliff Davis, who finished with 12 points and two steals. Oriekose Egbule added 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
